summary: 1. Total production clears target narrowly for a second straight day (+0.7%, 23,157 BCM), waste runs 8.9% under target, and ore beats target by +65.8% (4,898 BCM) — the strongest single-day ore beat since production resumed on Aug 18. 2. 2. MTD ore deficit narrows again, from -15.2% (Aug 18) to -11.9%, the second straight day the shortfall has closed rather than widened; MTD total production sits at -8.9%. 3. 3. Crusher stockpile-to-crusher throughput remains stuck at 49.9% of the 124,000 LCM monthly plan (barely moved from 48.6%) with only 5 fiscal days left in the 31-day cycle. 4. Survey reconciliation swings hard in 24 hours: Day 25 (Aug 19) posts the cycle's strongest positive gap yet (+16.92%), then Day 26 (Aug 20) reverses to -27.04%. 5. MTD survey gap: -59,510 BCM (-13.12%), and the required forward rate for the final 5 days climbs to roughly 42,649 BCM/day — well above every daily reading posted this cycle. 6. Two new fleet faults land: DT-108 relapses into a new brake-system fault description (front wheel jam / reseal master cylinder) without a Date Out between reports; DT-246 goes down for a coolant-alarm/ECM-engine failure, still open after two days. 7. EX-253, DT-109, and DT-346 all remain down unbroken — EX-253 now three-plus weeks down with no recovery date in any source. 8. An external EHSS alert lands from a different Maaden site (WAS Mine) — a Class 4 vehicle-reversing MVA, no injuries — shared group-wide for toolbox-talk learnings, not an ADW incident. 9. No new mining meeting notes. Two new Daily Availability Final Reports (18-Aug, 19-Aug) and two new survey workbooks (Day 25, Day 26) landed. `Workshop Daily Task 21-Aug-2026.pdf` and `Grade Control August 2026.xlsx` registered at index level only — same standing image-only / per-block-layout deferrals as every prior pass. Full detail in `RAW/_INGESTED.md`. Important References folder: re-checked, 32 files, no new content since the 89th pass. Task Feedback Log (Part C): "All Feedback" view queried, sorted by Date Logged descending — all 34 rows already carry `Status: Processed`, most recent dated 2026-07-30. No unprocessed rows found this pass, no Wiki edits triggered, no mismatches found. Articles updated (`Last updated` bumped to 2026-08-20): [[fleet-availability-utilization]] — Aug 18-19 dated section (DT-108 relapse, DT-246 new fault, standing long-term register). [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] — Days 25-26 dated section. [[daily-production-report]] — Aug 19 dated section. [[grade-control-june-2026]] — workbook re-read note, no new parse. [[safety-inspection-patterns]] — external WAS Mine EHSS alert. `Wiki/INDEX.md` one-line descriptions refreshed for all five articles. No content removed or renamed.
